plan.primary_cohort: Original unaware cohort, >=12h fasting, complete targets; unchanged
plan.partitions: Recover exact original split_manifest; 2024 has already been inspected in prior work
plan.status: Exploratory extension on reused temporal holdout, not a new external validation
plan.household: cfam 1 = single_person; 2-6 = multi_person (6 top coded); 9/missing = unknown; genertn cross-check only
plan.calibration: 2023 calibration subset only; temperature for all models
plan.comparison: same train rows, imputation/scaling, temporal partitions and survey weights
plan.household_ablation: base vs additional living_alone one-hot; three paired seeds, no best-seed selection
plan.specialist_models: one seed42 NN per household/age subset if all partitions have >=10 per outcome and training n>=100
plan.inference: exploratory unweighted complete-case logit, PSU-cluster SE, age/smoking and living/smoking interactions
plan.ci: 300 paired resamples of eligible PSUs inside year-strata; exploratory domain approximation
plan.promotion: no automatic replacement of original model based on this reused holdout

associations.method: Unweighted complete-case maximum-likelihood logit; year-PSU clustered SE; not full survey design inference

adjusted.formula: target ~ living_alone + age + C(sex) + C(incm) + C(edu) + HE_wc + sm_presnt + dr_month + pa_aerobic + C(survey_year)

interactions.formula: target ~ living_alone + age + C(sex) + C(incm) + C(edu) + HE_wc + sm_presnt + dr_month + pa_aerobic + C(survey_year) + age30 + age30:sm_presnt + living_alone:sm_presnt
